item.description:
Hush 2.0 is a complete overhaul: a new notebook, notes that never hold up your next call, and a lot more resilience.
**A new notebook** - A native sidebar with search excerpts, a Home page (start recording, what's coming up with Join & record, open action items, recent meetings) and an Action items list across every meeting. - Each meeting has Notes and Transcript views. Check off action items, edit notes by hand, rename the meeting with a click, and rename speakers ("Them" → "Priya"). - While recording, your notes and the live transcript sit side by side under a large timer. - Search, find in transcript, and play back kept audio from any line. - A redesigned menu bar popover, meeting card and welcome flow, settings with an in-app template editor, and a calmer graphite accent.
**Ask about a meeting** - A new Ask tab answers questions about one meeting from its notes, side notes and transcript ("What did we decide?", "What do I owe people?"), with timestamps you can follow back to the conversation. - It uses your chosen notes model. With the defaults, questions are answered entirely on this Mac. Cloud models ask before anything is sent, and answers are only kept if you add them to your side notes.
**Works the way you work** - Start the next recording while the last meeting's notes are still being written. Progress shows as "Reading part 3 of 8". - Long meetings finish: each part of a long transcript gets its own time limit. - Copy formatted notes for Mail, Notes, Docs or Slack, start an email, save the transcript, or send action items to Reminders. - Start and stop recording from anywhere with ⌃⌥⌘R. The menu bar shows elapsed time while recording. Hush appears in the Dock while a window is open. Each can be turned off in Settings.
**More reliable** - Switching microphones or speakers mid-call (AirPods, a headset) keeps recording. - Recording stops cleanly before sleep, keeps the Mac awake while it runs, and checks for disk space. - If Hush quits mid-meeting, the next launch repairs the saved audio and, with on-device models, finishes the notes automatically. - One unreadable meeting no longer hides the rest, and settings can't be reset by a future update. - Side notes typed while notes are being written are kept.
Your meetings, settings and templates carry over unchanged. Default models still run entirely on this Mac. The Anthropic default is now Claude Opus 5.5.
Verified with 163 automated tests, an Apple-notarized build and signed updates. Apple Silicon; macOS 26 or later.

Side notes and local AI models are here.
- Write an agenda, names, questions or rough thoughts in the new Side notes panel. Notes autosave per meeting, work during recording and after a meeting, and stay separate from generated output. - Choose whether side notes are used as AI context. Update AI notes after edits; your original text is preserved. Compact windows show the editor inline, and the toolbar can hide it. - Use downloaded Llama, Gemma, Qwen and other chat models through Ollama, or a local OpenAI-compatible server in LM Studio / llama.cpp. In Settings → Models → Notes, select the local provider, click Find models, choose a model, and test it with a short example. - Local provider connections stay on this Mac's loopback addresses. Remote providers still require HTTPS. Cloud-backed Ollama models are refused before meeting content is sent, and Hush never downloads models or falls back to cloud AI automatically. - Keeps the recording recovery fixes from 1.1.1, including bounded transcription shutdown and safe processing cancellation.
Verified with 129 tests, including real Apple Speech, Apple on-device notes, and Llama 3.2 using synthetic meeting content and side notes. Local model accuracy varies; review generated notes. Apple Silicon; macOS 26 or later.

Fixes a recording that could stay on “Finishing the transcript…” when the other side of a call produced no audio.
- Empty audio channels now finish immediately; transcription shutdown has a deadline and properly cancels Apple Speech. - Processing can be cancelled safely. Saved recordings and transcripts remain available for retry, and controls recover after errors. - Model tests show progress and results directly in Settings. The on-device notes test now generates notes from a short example. - Adds private, local diagnostic logs under Settings → Privacy. Logs contain processing steps and error numbers, never meeting content, audio or API keys, and are never uploaded.
Verified with 112 automated tests, including real on-device speech and notes using synthetic inputs. Apple Silicon; macOS 26 or later.
If version 1.1.0 is already stuck, force quit Hush once, reopen it, then choose Check for Updates. After installing, select the unfinished meeting and click Retry transcription to recover its saved audio.
